1. **Tech Stack Migration:** Appears that @knowledge-base is a TypeScript/JavaScript version of the Python-based @knowledge directory

2. **Package Structure:** @knowledge-base is structured as an installable package with proper module exports

3. **Data Consistency:** Core data (case files, URL lists) is consistent between both directories

<details><summary>Tool use: **edit_file** • Edit file: packages/knowledge-base/scripts/python-to-ts-converter.js</summary>

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,83 @@

+ #!/usr/bin/env node
+ 
+ const fs = require("fs");
+ const path = require("path");
+ 
+ /**
+  * Converts Python list syntax to JSON array
+  * @param {string} pythonContent - Python file content
+  * @returns {Object} - JSON object with extracted data
+  */
+ function convertPythonToJson(pythonContent) {
+ 	try {
+ 		// Extract Python lists - this is a simple implementation and might need adjustments
+ 		// for more complex Python structures
+ 		const listMatch = pythonContent.match(/(\w+)\s*=\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\]/);
+ 
+ 		if (!listMatch) {
+ 			console.error("No list variable found in Python file");
+ 			return null;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		const variableName = listMatch[1];
+ 		const listContent = listMatch[2];
+ 
+ 		// Parse the items - assuming they're strings in quotes
+ 		const itemsString = listContent.replace(/\n/g, "");
+ 		const items = itemsString.match(/'[^']*'|"[^"]*"/g) || [];
+ 
+ 		// Clean up quotes
+ 		const cleanItems = items.map((item) =&gt;
+ 			item.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "").trim(),
+ 		);
+ 
+ 		// Create JSON object with the same structure
+ 		const jsonObj = {
+ 			[variableName]: cleanItems,
+ 		};
+ 
+ 		return jsonObj;
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error converting Python to JSON:", error);
+ 		return null;
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Main function to process Python files
+  */
+ function main() {
+ 	const args = process.argv.slice(2);
+ 
+ 	if (args.length &lt; 2) {
+ 		console.log(
+ 			"Usage: node python-to-ts-converter.js &lt;python-file&gt; &lt;output-file&gt;",
+ 		);
+ 		process.exit(1);
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	const pythonFile = args[0];
+ 	const outputFile = args[1];
+ 
+ 	try {
+ 		// Read Python file
+ 		const pythonContent = fs.readFileSync(pythonFile, "utf8");
+ 
+ 		// Convert to JSON
+ 		const jsonData = convertPythonToJson(pythonContent);
+ 		if (!jsonData) {
+ 			console.error("Conversion failed");
+ 			process.exit(1);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Write to output file
+ 		fs.writeFileSync(outputFile, JSON.stringify(jsonData, null, 2));
+ 		console.log(&#96;Successfully converted ${pythonFile} to ${outputFile}&#96;);
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error processing file:", error);
+ 		process.exit(1);
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ main();
+
```

```diff
+ #!/usr/bin/env node
+ 
+ const fs = require("fs");
+ const path = require("path");
+ const { execSync } = require("child_process");
+ 
+ // Define paths
+ const sourceDir = path.resolve(
+ 	__dirname,
+ 	"../../../apps/disclosure-rag/knowledge",
+ );
+ const targetDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "../");
+ const scriptDir = __dirname;
+ 
+ console.log("Starting knowledge directory merge...");
+ 
+ /**
+  * Create directory if it doesn't exist
+  */
+ function ensureDir(dirPath) {
+ 	if (!fs.existsSync(dirPath)) {
+ 		fs.mkdirSync(dirPath, { recursive: true });
+ 		console.log(&#96;Created directory: ${dirPath}&#96;);
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Copy directory recursively
+  */
+ function copyDir(src, dest) {
+ 	ensureDir(dest);
+ 	const entries = fs.readdirSync(src, { withFileTypes: true });
+ 
+ 	for (const entry of entries) {
+ 		const srcPath = path.join(src, entry.name);
+ 		const destPath = path.join(dest, entry.name);
+ 
+ 		// Skip Python-specific files and directories
+ 		if (
+ 			entry.name === "__pycache__" ||
+ 			entry.name === "__init__.py" ||
+ 			entry.name === ".DS_Store"
+ 		) {
+ 			continue;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		if (entry.isDirectory()) {
+ 			copyDir(srcPath, destPath);
+ 		} else {
+ 			// Handle Python files special case
+ 			if (entry.name.endsWith(".py")) {
+ 				if (entry.name === "external_resources.py") {
+ 					// Convert Python to JSON using the converter script
+ 					try {
+ 						const outputPath = path.join(
+ 							targetDir,
+ 							entry.name.replace(".py", ".json"),
+ 						);
+ 
+ 						console.log(&#96;Converting ${srcPath} to ${outputPath}&#96;);
+ 						execSync(
+ 							&#96;node ${path.join(scriptDir, "python-to-ts-converter.js")} "${srcPath}" "${outputPath}"&#96;,
+ 						);
+ 					} catch (error) {
+ 						console.error(&#96;Error converting ${entry.name}:&#96;, error.message);
+ 					}
+ 				}
+ 				// Skip copying Python files
+ 				continue;
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			// Copy regular files
+ 			try {
+ 				fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath);
+ 				console.log(&#96;Copied ${srcPath} to ${destPath}&#96;);
+ 			} catch (error) {
+ 				console.error(&#96;Error copying ${srcPath}:&#96;, error.message);
+ 			}
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Process vector_storage directory specifically
+  */
+ function processVectorStorage() {
+ 	const sourceVectorDir = path.join(sourceDir, "vector_storage");
+ 	const targetVectorDir = path.join(targetDir, "vector_storage");
+ 
+ 	// Create vector_storage directory if needed
+ 	ensureDir(targetVectorDir);
+ 
+ 	// Copy CSV file if it doesn't exist in target or is newer
+ 	const sourceCsvPath = path.join(sourceVectorDir, "vector_store_files.csv");
+ 	const targetCsvPath = path.join(targetVectorDir, "vector_store_files.csv");
+ 
+ 	if (fs.existsSync(sourceCsvPath)) {
+ 		const copyNeeded =
+ 			!fs.existsSync(targetCsvPath) ||
+ 			fs.statSync(sourceCsvPath).mtime &gt; fs.statSync(targetCsvPath).mtime;
+ 
+ 		if (copyNeeded) {
+ 			fs.copyFileSync(sourceCsvPath, targetCsvPath);
+ 			console.log(&#96;Copied ${sourceCsvPath} to ${targetCsvPath}&#96;);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Convert CSV to JSON if needed
+ 	if (fs.existsSync(targetCsvPath)) {
+ 		const targetJsonPath = path.join(
+ 			targetVectorDir,
+ 			"vector-store-files.json",
+ 		);
+ 
+ 		try {
+ 			// Read CSV
+ 			const csvData = fs.readFileSync(targetCsvPath, "utf8");
+ 			const lines = csvData.split("\n");
+ 
+ 			// Parse headers
+ 			const headers = lines[0].split(",");
+ 
+ 			// Parse data
+ 			const jsonData = [];
+ 			for (let i = 1; i &lt; lines.length; i++) {
+ 				if (lines[i].trim() === "") continue;
+ 
+ 				const values = lines[i].split(",");
+ 				const row = {};
+ 
+ 				headers.forEach((header, index) =&gt; {
+ 					row[header.trim()] = values[index] ? values[index].trim() : "";
+ 				});
+ 
+ 				jsonData.push(row);
+ 			}
+ 
+ 			// Write JSON
+ 			fs.writeFileSync(targetJsonPath, JSON.stringify(jsonData, null, 2));
+ 			console.log(&#96;Converted ${targetCsvPath} to ${targetJsonPath}&#96;);
+ 		} catch (error) {
+ 			console.error(&#96;Error converting CSV to JSON:&#96;, error.message);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Process transcripts directory
+  */
+ function processTranscripts() {
+ 	const sourceTranscriptsDir = path.join(sourceDir, "transcripts");
+ 	const targetTranscriptsDir = path.join(targetDir, "transcripts");
+ 
+ 	// Skip if source doesn't exist
+ 	if (!fs.existsSync(sourceTranscriptsDir)) {
+ 		console.log("Source transcripts directory does not exist, skipping");
+ 		return;
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	// Create target directory
+ 	ensureDir(targetTranscriptsDir);
+ 
+ 	// Copy new transcripts
+ 	const entries = fs.readdirSync(sourceTranscriptsDir, { withFileTypes: true });
+ 
+ 	for (const entry of entries) {
+ 		if (!entry.isDirectory() || entry.name === ".DS_Store") continue;
+ 
+ 		const sourceEntryPath = path.join(sourceTranscriptsDir, entry.name);
+ 		const targetEntryPath = path.join(targetTranscriptsDir, entry.name);
+ 
+ 		// Copy if doesn't exist in target
+ 		if (!fs.existsSync(targetEntryPath)) {
+ 			copyDir(sourceEntryPath, targetEntryPath);
+ 			console.log(&#96;Copied new transcript directory: ${entry.name}&#96;);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Process case_files directory
+  */
+ function processCaseFiles() {
+ 	const sourceCaseDir = path.join(sourceDir, "case_files");
+ 	const targetCaseDir = path.join(targetDir, "case_files");
+ 
+ 	// Create case_files directory if needed
+ 	ensureDir(targetCaseDir);
+ 
+ 	// Copy all files from source to target
+ 	const entries = fs.readdirSync(sourceCaseDir, { withFileTypes: true });
+ 
+ 	for (const entry of entries) {
+ 		if (entry.name === ".DS_Store") continue;
+ 
+ 		const sourcePath = path.join(sourceCaseDir, entry.name);
+ 		const targetPath = path.join(targetCaseDir, entry.name);
+ 
+ 		if (entry.isDirectory()) {
+ 			copyDir(sourcePath, targetPath);
+ 		} else {
+ 			fs.copyFileSync(sourcePath, targetPath);
+ 			console.log(&#96;Copied ${sourcePath} to ${targetPath}&#96;);
+ 		}
+ 	}
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Update index.ts to export all resources
+  */
+ function updateIndexFile() {
+ 	const indexPath = path.join(targetDir, "index.ts");
+ 	const content = &#96;// Export knowledge resources and data
+ import externalResources from './external_resources.json';
+ 
+ // Case files data can be imported directly
+ // Vector storage data is available in vector_storage/
+ 
+ // Default export for easy importing
+ export default {
+   externalResources
+ };
+ 
+ // Named exports for specific imports
+ export { externalResources };
+ &#96;;
+ 
+ 	fs.writeFileSync(indexPath, content);
+ 	console.log("Updated index.ts file");
+ }
+ 
+ // Run each process
+ try {
+ 	processVectorStorage();
+ 	processTranscripts();
+ 	processCaseFiles();
+ 	updateIndexFile();
+ 
+ 	console.log("Knowledge directory merge completed successfully!");
+ } catch (error) {
+ 	console.error("An error occurred during merge:", error);
+ 	process.exit(1);
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * Convert Python list syntax to JSON object
+  */
+ function convertPythonToJson(pythonContent) {
+ 	try {
+ 		// Extract Python lists - this is a simple implementation
+ 		const listMatch = pythonContent.match(/(\w+)\s*=\s*\[([\s\S]*?)\]/);
+ 
+ 		if (!listMatch) {
+ 			console.error("No list variable found in Python file");
+ 			return { urls: [] };
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		const variableName = listMatch[1];
+ 		const listContent = listMatch[2];
+ 
+ 		// Parse the items - assuming they're strings in quotes
+ 		const itemsString = listContent.replace(/\n/g, "");
+ 		const items = itemsString.match(/'[^']*'|"[^"]*"/g) || [];
+ 
+ 		// Clean up quotes
+ 		const cleanItems = items.map((item) =&gt;
+ 			item.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "").trim(),
+ 		);
+ 
+ 		// Create JSON object with the same structure
+ 		return {
+ 			[variableName]: cleanItems,
+ 		};
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error converting Python to JSON:", error);
+ 		return { urls: [] };
+ 	}
+ }
```
